chart.title: Access to sexual and reproductive health care
chart.subtitle: Extent to which countries have regulations that guarantee full and equal access to women and men aged 15 years and older to sexual and reproductive health care. Index of specific legal enablers and barriers for 13 sexual health components. Higher values indicate greater access.
selection: Northern Africa and Western Asia (UN SDG)
